tasks.objective: Cart-pole case normalized to reference-consistent acceptance criteria. Scenario time window 0s to 20s; inputs: disturbance_force_N_profile, enable, reset, x_ref

constraint_set.source_text: Cart-pole case normalized to reference-consistent acceptance criteria. Scenario time window 0s to 20s; inputs: disturbance_force_N_profile, enable, reset, x_ref_m_profile; initial conditions: theta_bias_rps, theta_dot_rps, theta_rad, x_dot_mps, x_m. Acceptance criteria: within_range(force_cmd_N) in [-15.0, 15.0]; within_range(x_m) in [-0.8, 0.8]; within_range(mode) in [0.0, 1.0]; abs(bias_hat_rps - -4.3109201386) at t=20.0s <= 0.01; abs(x_m - 0.52) at t=20.0s <= 0.15; abs(theta_hat_rad - theta_rad) at t=20.0s <= 2.0.
